# pvecli vm shutdown

Shutdown one or more VMs gracefully.

```text
pvecli vm shutdown [VMIDS] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VMIDS` | VM ID(s) - single, comma-separated, or range (e.g., 100, 100,101, 100-105). |

## Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` |  | Profile to use. |
| `--tag VALUE` |  | Target the guests carrying this tag. |
| `--pool VALUE` |  | Target the guests of this resource pool. |
| `--node VALUE` |  | Target the guests currently on this node. |
| `-t`, `--timeout N` | `60` | Timeout before force stop. |
| `--force` |  | Force stop after timeout. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Skip confirmation. |
